what.text: This page follows refugees from Uzbekistan living in Russia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 221 Uzbek refugees in Russia, 4.3% of all refugees from Uzbekistan.
The United States hosts the most Uzbek refugees, followed by Germany, Sweden and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Uzbekistan with the IMU in 1999 and 2000, and with JIG in 2004.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1996 to 1998, come before those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at its highest figure, 33780 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Russia.
These are year-end totals for Russia only, reported to UNHCR.
